steps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original AI cultural illustration for an interactive expanding screen about Weifang kites in Shandong.

Create one invented symmetrical Chinese folk-art kite, inspired by the decorative spirit of Weifang kite-making but not copying any actual kite, named artist's design, museum object or photograph. Make it an obviously recognizable, complete butterfly-like kite: a narrow upright body, paired balanced wings, a few suggested slender bamboo-like spars and painted paper surfaces. Crisp simple folk ornament, joyous but refined, not an actual engineering pattern or craft demonstration.
Composition: full kite near the center of a wide horizontal picture with clear silhouette and breathing room; put its central body and unmistakable patterned wing roots in the middle 25–30% of image width so an accordion panel's narrow center crop retains the kite identity. The outer wings are allowed to extend to either side for the full landscape composition. Background: light pale teal sky, gentle paper-cloud shapes and subtle texture. Emphasize an original palette of vermilion, warm gold, indigo, leaf green and ivory, as in an elevated hand-painted paper-cut illustration.
Constraints: imaginary artwork only, no person, hands, kite making, identifiable place or actual sky event. No replica of a known traditional pattern or an artist's work. No text, Chinese characters, numerals, signage, logos, signatures, seals, watermark, frame, or user-interface elements.
